brief.description: Names the session's brief, so sil records this call against the want behind it. A brief that is not the buyer's answers `not_found`.

items.description: An id sil minted, passed back verbatim.

ids.description: Sends the variant ids it wants priced.

ship_to.description: Reads every seller's `ships` and shipping terms against one of the buyer's addresses on file, named by its label; the default address when absent.

key.description: Names the key from the domain read; `price` is a key every domain has.

op.description: Sends the operator the domain read listed for this key.

value.description: Sends the desired value, typed by the key's type.

currency.description: Required on money: sil holds no exchange rate, so the bound is tested against offers in this currency only, and `eur` matches no offer sil stores.

seller_specs.description: Sends the seller specs this call asks, written by the agent from the brief's — keys of the domain read's `seller_specs`, base and branch.
